# Three steps: the prefill, then two decode steps of three kernels each.
# Decode step 1 idles 2µs+3µs, step 2 1µs+1µs; the median of two is the
# longer.
nsysgaps -end argmax -floor 2ms -floor 100us -api $WORK/api.csv $WORK/gpu.csv
stdout '9 kernels, 3 steps ending in "argmax"; skipping 1'
stdout '^ +1 +3 +25µs +20µs +5µs +2.5µs +20.0%$'
stdout 'median step: 3 launches, span 25µs, busy 20µs, idle 5µs \(2.5µs per launch\)'
stdout '^ +3µs idle +1 launches +5µs busy  argmax$'
stdout 'floor +2ms -> step +2.005ms, idle +0.2% of step'
stdout 'floor +100µs -> step +105µs, idle +4.8% of step'
stdout 'cuLaunchKernel +3 calls +9µs total +3µs mean'
stdout 'cuGraphLaunch +1 calls +20µs total +20µs mean'

# Every step is skipped.
! nsysgaps -end argmax -skip 3 $WORK/gpu.csv
stderr '3 steps ending in "argmax", need more than 3'

# A missing column refuses the file.
! nsysgaps $WORK/bad.csv
stderr 'no "Duration \(ns\)" column'

! nsysgaps
stderr usage
